tez: Target Corporation demonstrates resilient top-line momentum with 6.7 percent YoY revenue growth and 9.9 percent gross profit growth in fiscal Q1 2026, alongside robust operating cash flow generation of 716.0 million USD (up 160.4 percent YoY). Despite short-term operating profit compression from cost inflation, TGT maintains a solid balance sheet with 3,534.0 million USD in cash easily covering 1,133.0 million USD of current debt maturities, low refinancing risk, an above-peer-median earnings yield of 5.09 percent, and a 6/9 Piotroski F-score. The investment thesis centers on sustained revenue growth and gross margin stability expanding operating margins back toward historical levels.
